Radarr has the same change outstanding as e80abdd60 in 2026-08, and the backend half is Radarr's to own - taking the Sonarr copy now would guarantee a conflicting second port. Deferred to the Radarr chunk so both halves land together.

f3b39ba4f7abd8e454c16d0469086c09f66aff6f.subject: New: Display multiple audio and subtitles streams in media info
f3b39ba4f7abd8e454c16d0469086c09f66aff6f.reason: Multiple audio and subtitle streams in media info: migration 225 restructures MediaInfoModel into per-stream models and rewrites FileNameBuilder tokens, XBMC metadata and the Discord/Trakt/CustomScript/Webhook payloads. Raised as a product decision, not a sync decision, and declined for this chunk.

c70de927a5113a3029478c539ca0f7f3095e07e9.subject: Avoid unique constraints for primary keys in SQLite migrations
c70de927a5113a3029478c539ca0f7f3095e07e9.reason: SqliteSchemaDumper marked primary-key columns UNIQUE when rebuilding a table from its dumped schema, adding an index SQLite already provides implicitly.

0d80c093ffd4f07bd46249ab7d48a9e5272fda62.subject: Prevent empty path from breaking custom script validation
0d80c093ffd4f07bd46249ab7d48a9e5272fda62.reason: An empty custom script Path fell through IsValidPath into SystemFolderValidator, which threw instead of reporting a validation failure. Cascade on first failure and reject empty up front. Adapted for our generic SystemFolderValidator<T>.

06c6062531d87f77787e435d57366c34bd8f2f79.subject: Add v5 Connection endpoints
06c6062531d87f77787e435d57366c34bd8f2f79.reason: Took the non-V5 half only: the Plex Server Port field now declares FieldType.Number so it renders as a number input. The Sonarr.Api.V5 Connections endpoints have no counterpart project here.

b2f2c21a61eea3eec213af045853b5a5d27a754f.subject: New: Return error if invalid indexer or download client provided for pushed releases
b2f2c21a61eea3eec213af045853b5a5d27a754f.reason: /api/v3/release/push silently ignored an unknown indexer or download client name. Added ResolveIndexer/ResolveDownloadClient to the factories with 400-returning exceptions, rewired our V3 ReleasePushController, and ported both fixtures. Two deliberate departures: ReleaseInfo.IndexerId is a non-nullable int, so an omitted indexer arrives as 0 and upstream's straight pass-through would reject the push - mapped to null here; and the duplicate ResolveDownloadClient upstream also added to DownloadClientProvider is left out, since it is not on IProvideDownloadClient and nothing calls it.

399ca1661fccfd38723caf4ec79f8775751426ac.subject: New: Ability to set command priority when starting command via API
399ca1661fccfd38723caf4ec79f8775751426ac.reason: Command priority becomes a property of the posted resource instead of a hardcoded ManualImportCommand special case. Adapted to our V3 CommandController, whose code was identical to upstream's pre-change V5. The interactive import modal asks for High so the UI path keeps the priority it had; other API clients posting ManualImport without a priority now get Normal, which is the point of the change.

41b0ecb08c6dbf4de9d986791a6b42e1a93af9db.subject: Increase width of Organize and Rename modal
41b0ecb08c6dbf4de9d986791a6b42e1a93af9db.reason: Organize and Rename modal widened to EXTRA_EXTRA_LARGE.

70678510eed5d7dd19e4f54f99b394b4c38581e4.subject: Use theme appropriate colors for image background on initial load
70678510eed5d7dd19e4f54f99b394b4c38581e4.reason: Poster and headshot placeholders painted --defaultColor, a foreground colour, so every grid flashed dark tiles before images resolved. Switched to --movieBackgroundColor, which already tracks the theme. Applied across the movie, scene, performer and studio grids plus collection and credit posters; the MovieIndexPosterSelect check circle keeps --defaultColor because it is a deliberate contrast chip, not an image placeholder.

28300ffb2b57936b554724d9b339b76dd837114b.subject: Add aria-labels to sidebar status
28300ffb2b57936b554724d9b339b76dd837114b.reason: The sidebar queue and health counters rendered a bare number with no accessible name. PageSidebarStatus now forwards span props to Label. The four en.json keys were authored here in sorted position rather than taken from the upstream hunk.

276e67b5fa5dba1ee55909da3f72335a3a484e49.subject: Add alt text for series images
276e67b5fa5dba1ee55909da3f72335a3a484e49.reason: MovieImage rendered every image with no alt attribute. Added a required title prop and a cover-type-aware alt string, updating all twenty call sites across movie, scene, performer, studio and collection. Cover types differ from upstream's (screenshot, headshot and clearlogo instead of season), so the alt keys are ours and authored in sorted position.

ae13ce4ac6df6851db1740471761783adb35b182.subject: Improve tab behaviour
ae13ce4ac6df6851db1740471761783adb35b182.reason: Tab in an empty search box ran a search for the empty string and blurred the input instead of moving focus; the hover-only poster action buttons stayed in the tab order behind an invisible overlay. Applied to MovieSearchInput and all four index posters.

b88b7e15c1b64e723f7898cf58a3227eb5cf69a5.subject: Fixed: Reduce data transfer when reading video stream from files
b88b7e15c1b64e723f7898cf58a3227eb5cf69a5.reason: Picks the ffprobe -select_streams index by position within VideoStreams rather than by absolute stream index, so HDR frame analysis reads the right stream. VideoFileInfoReader already carries the final form of this, refined by 302b0f356.

302b0f356e7c26de8c90bc874ca63ba3bb862d8d.subject: Fallback to video stream 0 when reading primary video for frame analysis
302b0f356e7c26de8c90bc874ca63ba3bb862d8d.reason: Falls back to video stream 0 when the primary video stream is not found in VideoStreams. Already present verbatim in our VideoFileInfoReader.

1033849d399535f981d88c7bc637cdb4180d129c.subject: Fix translation key for banner in SeriesImage component
1033849d399535f981d88c7bc637cdb4180d129c.reason: Corrects the alt-text key for banners from 'Banner' to 'ImageBanner' in Sonarr's SeriesImage. Our MovieImage alt text was written in this chunk and already uses ImageBanner, with keys authored in sorted position.
